column1: Purpose: Log every transaction from your business bank accounts, payment processors, and credit cards, real cash in and real cash out, so you always know your actual Net Profit and Net Margin.
1. Enter every transaction from your business bank accounts, payment processors, and credit cards. Only count money that has actually hit or left one of your accounts.
2. Don't include signed contracts, unpaid invoices, expected revenue, or payouts still sitting with a processor. If it's not in your account yet, it hasn't happened yet.
3. Set Type to Revenue, Expense, or Transfer. Transfers between your own accounts don't count as revenue or expense, or you'll count the same money twice.
4. Pick a Category for every transaction so you can see where the money is actually going, don't dump things into a vague catch-all.
5. Currency and Conversion Rate default to USD and 1, only change them for transactions in another currency.
6. Amount in Reporting Currency fills in on its own from what you enter.
